label: Floor
description: Raises the value to at least this

label: Ceiling
description: Lowers the value to at most this

label: Truncated normal
description: p1 = mean, p2 = sd, p3 = lo, p4 = hi

label: Lognormal
description: p1 = log mean, p2 = log sd

label: Triangular
description: p1 = lo, p2 = mode, p3 = hi

label: Categorical
description: Uses the categories and weights columns

label: Sourced
description: A citation was read and supports this value

label: Invented
description: No measurement exists; the model needs a number

label: Parked
description: Deliberately not used; the notes say why

label: Ambulatory difficulty
description: Walks and uses stairs, but slower and tires sooner

label: Walker or cane
description: Uses an aid; stairs are slow and tiring

label: Wheelchair
description: Cannot use stairs; needs the lift or assistance

label: Caregiver
description: Paired with someone who cannot use stairs

label: Parent
description: An older parent living with the household

label: Lodger
description: Shares the flat without being family

label: Carer
description: Lives in to assist another member

label: Would knock
description: Would knock on their door on the way out

label: Would phone
description: Would call or message them directly

label: Same floor
description: Only between people on one floor

label: Per pair
description: The rate is the chance that any one eligible pair is tied

label: Ties per person
description: The rate is the average number of ties a person has, which does not change when the building gets bigger

label: Poor
description: Corridor only; a quarter may not hear it

label: Age
description: Share of residents by age band

label: Mobility
description: Share of residents by mobility category

label: Absence
description: Share of residents not in the building

label: Pet
description: Share of households keeping a pet

label: Tenure
description: Share of residents by years in the building

label: SIPP
description: Survey of Income and Program Participation

label: Team
description: Agreed by the team without a source

label: Showering
description: Cannot hear the alarm and is not dressed
